plan.title: Messages: buyer sends to Vendor A and receives reply

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ event with two bids; this must be the first step for a prepared-state case.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before opening the prepared event.
Open the RFQ stage where the Messages control is available.
Select Vendor A as the message recipient.
Enter the message requested by the case.
Send the buyer's message to Vendor A.
Verify the sent message is visible in the buyer-side thread.
Switch to Vendor A's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared event's overview in Vendor A's portal.
Open the event messages from the vendor portal.
Verify Vendor A can see the buyer's message.
Enter a reply from Vendor A.
Verify the vendor portal shows the reply in the thread.
Return to the buyer's browser session.
Verify the buyer sees Vendor A's reply in the message thread.
